scripts.docker:vendor: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm vendor-init
scripts.docker:analyse: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm vendor-init php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon --memory-limit=512M
scripts.docker:rector: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm vendor-init php vendor/bin/rector process
scripts.docker:rector:dry: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm vendor-init php vendor/bin/rector process --dry-run
